title: Seed-floor diameter guard bounds the wrong envelope: floors provably unsatisfiable on a single-router mesh load clean and silently stall growth
detail: Every SEED candidate is drawn within connect span (18) of a live junction; with one junction, candidate–terminal distance ≤ 2×span = 36, so floors 37–49 load clean but no candidate can ever clear them — permanent silent stall.
recommended_fix: Bound new_area_seed_tiles by the draw envelope (e.g. reject ≥ 2×max era span, or document the diameter check as cosmetic); fail-fast naming the key.

title: New key parsed with plain jint: decimal values silently truncate, out-of-i32 integers wrap to a different valid value
detail: `new_area_seed_tiles: 10.5` loads as 10; `4294967306` wraps through the i32 cast to 10. Both load clean with a value the author never wrote — the silent-truncation bar jint_strict exists to enforce.
recommended_fix: Switch the growth_groups block (or at least the new key) to jint_strict, rejecting non-integer/out-of-range values naming the key, matching terminal_min_sep_tiles.
